scope: Jamaican life, health, group and retirement products, with separate offshore references.
limitations: Carrier listing confirms a published reference, not current new-business availability or agency distribution authority.
All brochure editions, rates, waiting periods and policy terms need carrier confirmation before quotation.
Media coverage corroborates announcements; contributed or quoted carrier statements are not independent policy verification.
Catalogue entries, legacy policy families and group arrangements are not a count of separately purchasable policies.
International broker partnerships remain unnamed and pending confirmation.

flags.title: Guardian Achiever entry age
flags.detail: Brochure states ages 1 to 15; carrier-supplied Gleaner coverage dated 27 September 2023 states six months to 15. Confirm base-plan and rider ages separately.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Family AIDE recurrence conflict
flags.detail: The carrier page describes termination on diagnosis, while its FAQ also describes recurrence. Media claim coverage distinguishes it from the recurrence plan. Do not state a definite recurrence benefit or absence until the policy edition is confirmed.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Family COMFORT waiting-period conflict
flags.detail: The benefits section states one year before terminal illness benefit; the same page FAQ states two years. Confirm the applicable edition.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Purple Shield coverage conflict
flags.detail: Jamaican product page gives up to J$12.5 million and age-banded limits, but retains J$3 million death-benefit text elsewhere. Do not select one as the current limit.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Triple Protector Plus coverage conflict
flags.detail: The Jamaican page retains J$3 million overview wording alongside J$10 million and J$9 million age-banded limits.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Maximum Protector coverage conflict
flags.detail: Previously retrieved official text has different minimums and maxima across sections. Current figures need a dated schedule.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Agri-Care enrolment restriction
flags.detail: Current page restricts Primary Care to members enrolled before 2026. The 2021 government launch notice cannot establish present options or rates.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: PPO existing-client restriction
flags.detail: Group catalogue identifies PPO for existing group health clients only. Other group arrangements also require scheme or employer eligibility.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Government scheme administration
flags.detail: Published references may describe older administration arrangements. Confirm the current insurer, administrator and eligibility before treating a scheme as available.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: Offshore distribution pending
flags.detail: A reference on the carrier broker catalogue does not confirm a Bulwark broker partnership or permission to distribute a Cayman-issued policy. Keep issuer and currency separate.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.

flags.title: JN COMFORT eligibility consistency
flags.detail: The main table and FAQ contain inconsistent age descriptions. Confirm current entry ages and coverage bands rather than quoting the FAQ alone.
flags.action: Request current policy wording, dated schedule and written carrier confirmation.
